name: TeamStarWolf - Impact: Destruction, Extortion & Disruption
description: Curated practitioner view of Impact: Destruction, Extortion & Disruption behaviors, not an official MITRE mapping. Techniques that damage availability or integrity: encryption for impact, wiping, defacement, denial of service, resource hijacking. Cross-tactic selection; scores indicate curated membership tier (core vs supporting). Every ID/tactic validated against the bundled ATT&CK v16 data.
